name: Subpage demo CTA above the footer
purpose: Close every subpage with one last invitation to talk to the team, sending the visitor to the demo page with a single button.
description: The SUBPAGE_CTA block that Footer renders above the footer card when its real `variant` prop is 'subpage' (Layout.jsx passes 'subpage' on every route except '/' and '/company', which get the 'home' variant = conversion.demo-form). A centred 40rem column, gap 2rem: Nimbus wordmark, H2 whose last three words are italic, an 18px ink paragraph (max 32rem) and one green accent pill button linking to /lms/demo-platform; no form. Padding 3rem (1.5rem at <=479); the column simply narrows on smaller screens. It sits inside the <footer> element, directly above the shared footer card.

evidenceNotes: Copy is a single constant (SUBPAGE_CTA in Footer.jsx), identical on all 56 registered routes other than / and /company (58 routes rendered via the page families); no page passes props to Footer (Layout.jsx renders it once with variant from FORM_FOOTER_PAGES = {'/', '/company'}).
The Footer.jsx comment says the paragraph is 18 words; the actual SUBPAGE_CTA.body is 20 words.
/company is a non-home route that keeps the 'home' variant (demo form, conversion.demo-form) per the Layout.jsx comment 'measured live 2026-10-09'.

The Wordmark above the heading is the brand mark (contract-owned), not modelled as content.
